author: Jeff Geerling
description:
Huge thanks to Adam (othermod) for sending over a PSPi 6 for me to test and review.

I wanted to try this out when I first heard about it in 2022... since then it's been completely overhauled! And better yet, it's open source with a CC BY-SA license.

Here are some links to things I mentioned in this video:

  - PSPi 6 Board: https://othermod.com/product/pspi-6-board/
  - Open Source files: https://github.com/othermod/PSPi-Version-6
  - CM5 PSPi Heatsink Mod: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dpj7oJ_UN2A
  - Heatsink mod based on: https://github.com/othermod/PSPi-Version-6/wiki/6.-Community-Mods#custom-cooling-modules
  - Macho Nacho Production's video on the PSPi: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PKXbAd7vXA4
  - Joe Cirillo's video on the PSP: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I7AeQFk00dQ
  - polymatt's custom PSP: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ORz3dcgBAVE

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/geerlingguy
Sponsor me on GitHub: https://github.com/sponsors/geerlingguy
